name: APC Smart-UPS SMT3000RMI2UC · 2U · AP9640 NMC3
source: DEPTH DATUM (user-entered, approximate): the user confirmed that 670 mm is the OVERALL length from the front of the bezel to the very rear of the unit, and that the ear flanges sit about 630 mm from the rear. depthMm is therefore 630 mm (ear plane to rear panel) and the front bezel is a separate solid projecting about 40 mm forward of the ear plane (z = -40 to 0 mm; 670 - 630). Both values are approximate user measurements. Placement note: the bezel needs at least 40 mm of clear depth in front of the mounting rails on the face it is mounted to; in a rear-mounted position it projects 40 mm behind the rear rails. Body 430 mm wide (user-entered; the width tape reads 43 cm) inside 482.6 mm (19-inch) ears (user-entered). Height 86.1 mm and mass 44.28 kg are the Schneider Electric brochure maximum values (W480 × D683 × H86.1 mm, 44.28 kg, 2U; https://ckm-content.se.com/ckmContent/sfc/servlet.shepherd/document/download/0691H00000FWcBtQAL); 480 mm is the brochure maximum width, not the body width, and the brochure 683 mm maximum depth does not match the user's 670 mm overall (possibly rear-panel fittings or the bezel profile; not resolved). Chassis geometry: a box body from the ear plane to the rear panel plus the "front-bezel" part, a solid 430 × 86.1 × 40 mm forward of the ear plane (projection user-entered, approximate; width and height ASSUMED equal to the body and PROVISIONAL; the bezel lies between the ears). The front bezel carries the APC logo, a slotted grille and the LCD panel with five buttons (power, Esc, Enter, up, down) on the right as seen from the front (user photos); these are controls, not cable endpoints, and are not modelled. Front face features are not added because they would render behind the bezel solid. The rear perforated cover plate is a visual grille only (position provisional). Rear panel (user photo): see each port for its label. The model label on the rear panel reads "SMT3000RMI2U" and no separate SmartConnect port is visible; the user names the unit SMT3000RMI2UC, which is kept here pending confirmation. The overload protector (push-to-reset button between the input and the C13 block) and the earth/ground screw beside the model label are not cable endpoints and are not modelled. The panel note "FOR BATTERY REPLACEMENT REMOVE FRONT BEZEL" means the bezel must be removable in place. Expansion: an APC AP9640 Network Management Card 3 is fitted in the SmartSlot (user-supplied configuration; the slot is empty in the photo). Its Network RJ45 and Console micro-USB are modelled as rear ports at provisional positions. Power: rating label (user photo) "MAX OUTPUT POWER RATING 3000VA/2700W" for the 3000 VA model, input 220–240 V 50/60 Hz, maximum input current 16 A. Banks: GROUP 1 (8 × C13, 10 A per receptacle group as printed) and the C19 output (16 A as printed), both at 230 V nominal within the printed 220–240 V range. SCHEMA GAP: the UPS total output limit (3000 VA, about 13.0 A at 230 V; 2700 W) cannot be expressed because power banks are independent, so the two banks together allow 26 A; check the total against 2700 W by hand. The UPS own draw (losses and battery charging) is not printed and is not set. Mounting: direct ear mounting as photographed. At 44 kg this unit should be supported on a rail or support kit; none is modelled or inferred, and no manufacturer rail kit is named. PROVISIONAL: ear thickness unknown (2 mm illustrative preview); each ear shows four holes in two pairs, one pair near the top and one near the bottom (user photos), entered as placeholder offsets 6.35/22.225/66.675/82.55 mm that are not measured; every port centre is a placeholder (see each port). No serial number, site or workplace detail from the photos is recorded.

powerBanks.name: Group 1 (8 × C13)
powerBanks.source: Printed on the rear panel beside the outlets (user photo): "GROUP 1" and "OUTPUT: 220-240V, 50/60Hz, 10A PER RECEPTACLE GROUP". The bank limit is the printed 10 A group rating; no separate per-outlet rating is printed, so the per-outlet limit is set to the same 10 A. 230 V is the nominal value within the printed 220–240 V range. This bank is independent of the C19 bank: the UPS total output limit (3000 VA / 2700 W) is NOT enforced across banks (schema gap).

powerBanks.name: C19 output
powerBanks.source: Printed on the rear panel above the C19 outlet (user photo): "OUTPUT: 220-240V, 50/60Hz, 16A". 230 V is the nominal value within the printed 220–240 V range. This bank is independent of GROUP 1: the UPS total output limit (3000 VA / 2700 W) is NOT enforced across banks (schema gap).
